### Sprint 6: Start and stop with an accurate state

A task receives only the services it has, and its stop result is shown correctly.

**Give the agent only its actual broker address ⚪ Not tested**

Test: Compare brokered and brokerless starts. Only a task with a broker receives its broker address; an agent reached by URL must not treat a relay as a broker.

Test: Stop a task with surviving processes and compare the daemon result with the interface. Both show the same actual integer count, including a nonzero case.

A project chooses the runtime explicitly and nested-container guarantees are measured.

**Use the separate kernel only with project opt-in ⚪ Not tested**

Test: Start projects with and without opt-in, then break rule installation. Only the opted-in project uses the new runtime; a start with ineffective rules is refused.

Nesting cannot extend allowed reach or bypass guarded mode.
